supporting_observations.claim: The alerted failures repeatedly target svc-inventory from FILE-BLU-01, with the same process path (lsass.exe), source address (10.54.20.20), and roughly one-minute cadence; this is consistent with the inventory job's documented re-authentication interval.
The failures report incorrect-password status (0xc000006a); corresponding domain-controller records also show that status, and Kerberos pre-authentication failures show status 0x18.

The observed source and recurring failure pattern fit the scheduled svc-inventory password rotation and the documented need to manually update the InventorySync job afterward; the evidence does not show an unfamiliar source or a successful logon.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records cover failed authentication attempts only; they do not establish whether there were successful logons elsewhere in the review window.
The records do not include the password-rotation event, InventorySync configuration or execution logs, or evidence that the job's credential was updated.
claims_not_established: The logs do not confirm that the scheduled password rotation occurred at 13:30 UTC or that the repeated failures were definitively caused by the job retaining an old password.
The logs do not establish whether any successful svc-inventory authentication or other activity occurred outside the supplied records.
additional_evidence_needed: As an operational follow-up, verify the password rotation and update the InventorySync job credential; check subsequent job and authentication logs for successful runs.
